newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Oct 25 foreign reserves at $8.16 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Oct 25 foreign reserves at $8.16 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $8.16 billion as of October 25, the most recent date for which official figures are available, the central bank said.
It said the figure marked the eighth consecutive week in which reserves had increased.
Net foreign reserves have decreased by $155.6 million, or 1.9 percent, since December 30 of last year, however.
On October 27, 1995, Colombia's net reserves totalled $8.38 billion.
